steps.content: You're momentarily lost on the boundless ice field. Afar, a just-formed ice storm is swarming toward you like in the last round, even faster and more intensely this time.
The name almost escapes your lips as you realize the reassuring presence of the swordswoman is already gone. Has she disappeared from this world for good?
The brilliant flash of the sword has long dimmed. Only the screeching cold wind accompanies you now. Watching your warm breaths turn white in the air, you can't help but shiver again.
How annoying.
Tetya's gone. You don't just stand around and wait like last time, but start running along the track you remember.
You could have just thought of this as a game, but...
The Game Master's snicker creeps into your mind.
(Transition)

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Those who fail the challenge will become <color=#fb9259>NPCs</color>. Though you broke Cyrus, I'm quite satisfied with your performance as a noob. I'll reward you by making you the next <color=#fb9259>Cyrus</color>!</color>

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Aren't you happy about that?</color>
Clearly, Cyrus isn't the answer to the world's salvation. He's only a villain played by a player. Your true opponent is the Dragon of Genesis who manipulates the fate of everything.
...Who's also the <color=#fb9259>Game Master</color> of this game.
Yes, you want to clear this game and teach this arrogant Game Master a lesson.
Clack!
You hear a loud, crisp noise. It sounds like something breaking. You whip your head around immediately.
Bang—
The still ice field begins quaking all of a sudden. Since you've dodged the ice storm, the Game Master now wants to take it a notch up and triggers a whole avalanche.
Shoving away the distracting thoughts, you start dashing at full speed. But this is nothing but useless resistance to the furious waves of silvery white snow.
The second before getting devoured by the snow, you remember that NPC who risked her life to save you. Indeed, she doesn't show up this time.
(Transition)

steps.speaker: Tetya
steps.content:
Promise...
Till... the world is saved...
(Scene change)
Oh my, how embarrassing...
Look at you... I've gotta dig you out...
And they say you're the Chosen One...?
All I see is just... <size=44>a giant carrot</size>... buried in the snow...
The bandit you've met once before is brushing snow off you. She pulls you out of the pile of snow.

steps.speaker: Female Bandit
steps.content: Hey, are you awake now, Chosen One?
She paces around you, occasionally running her hands all over you.

steps.speaker: Female Bandit
steps.content: Limp muscles, strengthless limbs, weak pulses... You plan to save the world with a body like that? I thought you were gonna launch an ultimate in the avalanche or something, turns out you're just a giant carrot that needs my rescue.

steps.speaker: Female Bandit
steps.content: Haha, got a sense of humor? How about this... You wanna come with me? Erwin's assigned me to help you.
Is she your ally in <color=#fb9259>this round</color>? You nod and let her guide you to the distant destination.
